title: Two outer coverings
hook: Body coverings can affect water loss.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The schematic compares a keratinized scaly surface with exposed moist skin. Many reptiles have a skin barrier that limits water loss; amphibian skin is often more permeable. Real water balance depends on species and conditions.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In this simplified comparison, which outer covering provides a stronger barrier against drying?
